name: PROMIS Physical Function
description: PROMIS Physical Function item bank. Available as full bank, CAT (4–6 items), or fixed short forms (4a, 6a, 8a, 10a, 20a). T-score scale (mean 50, SD 10); lower T = worse function.
shirleySays: SEM ~3 pts. MCID: ~4–6 T-score pts. ICC 0.92–0.97. Validated in ortho, neuro, cardiac, pulmonary, oncology, SCI, TKA/THA, LBP, fibromyalgia. CAT reduces burden to 4–6 items. Strongly correlated with 10MWT (r=0.60) and LEFS (r=0.72).

scoring.mcidNote: ~4–6 T-score pts MCID; T<40 = clinically limited
